Inside a 1952 Waco Home with Stunning Contemporary Updates! #homeforsale 

3600 Parkwood St • Waco, TX 🏡✨

Where mid-century character meets modern comfort.

Originally built in 1952, this Waco gem blends the craftsmanship of its era with fresh, contemporary updates — especially in the beautifully reimagined kitchen.

From the warm, open layout to the modern finishes that honor its architectural roots, this home is truly one-of-a-kind.

📍 3600 Parkwood St, Waco, TX 76710
🛏️ 3 Bedrooms | 🛁 2 Baths | 🧱 Classic Design + Modern Touches

Looking for a home that feels like Waco — timeless, stylish, and full of character? You’ll want to see this one in person.
